author: National Geographic
description:
The no-fear gene: In a country where the punishment for espionage is death, a young CIA officer — and the real-life inspiration for Carrie Matheson from “Homeland” — is kidnapped at gunpoint during a routine intel exchange. Isolated and under threat, she must rely on her training and instincts to survive a tense 24-hour standoff that could end in catastrophe.
